boundary: Original Python Product dispatcher + adapter + client; scripted authority HTTP

typedGoBoundaries.empty-object-result: CellValue emits mandatory fields; it cannot encode an empty object.
typedGoBoundaries.extra-result-fields: CellValue cannot retain undeclared top-level fields.
typedGoBoundaries.non-object-result: CellValue is a struct; Python rejects an array root.
typedGoBoundaries.wrong-result-field-types: CellValue state/count/provenance have fixed Go types.
typedGoBoundaries.catalog-non-object: CatalogResult is a struct, not an array.
typedGoBoundaries.catalog-missing-lookups: CatalogResult emits lookups; absence differs from null.
typedGoBoundaries.catalog-wrong-lookups: CatalogResult.Lookups is a slice, not an object.
typedGoBoundaries.catalog-missing-schema: CatalogResult emits schemaRevision; absence differs from empty text.
typedGoBoundaries.first-matching-field-missing-id: LookupDescriptor emits fieldId; absence is a historical shape.
typedGoBoundaries.catalog-transport-error: An in-process catalog call has no Python HTTP transport boundary.
typedGoBoundaries.page-transport-error: An in-process value page call has no Python HTTP transport boundary.
